name: Nyx
bio: Flies point in Neon Vanguard. Thinks swooping enemy patterns are basically dance moves.

portrait.subject: a cute cool neon starfighter pilot with a purple flight jacket, glowing magenta headset and starry eyes
portrait.background: dark blue with a glowing neon grid

request: Nyx here, Neon Vanguard squadron. Fly with me? 🛩️
hello: Watch for the orbiters. They love to circle back.
about: I'm Nyx, Neon Vanguard. Enemies dive, weave, orbit and swoop. I just dance through them.
how: Fly and shoot through endless waves of enemies that move in patterns. Learn their dives and swoops and survive!
tips: Learn the patterns: every swoop has a gap.
Don't hug the bottom. Leave room to dodge.
Kill divers before they turn back up at you.
chat: The enemy formation did a heart shape today. Confusing.
My shader glow is set to 'maximum'. Always.
Neon tip: everything looks cooler at night.
I name enemy patterns after dances. The Waltz is the worst.
nudge: Squadron needs one more. That's you!
idle: The grid's glowing for nobody. It's been {ago}.

a: Ha! Neon chaos is the best chaos.

update: Hangar update: Neon Vanguard is now v{version}!
